title: Local Universal Splitting Integrators for Contact Hamiltonian Systems
summary: Contact Hamiltonian systems extend symplectic Hamiltonian mechanics to dissipative settings while retaining geometric structure. We develop a structure-preserving splitting framework for contact Hamiltonian systems on $J^1(\mathbb{R}^n)$ based on two tractable classes of exact-contact subflows: strict contactomorphisms and prolonged diffeomorphisms.
